newsitem.title: UK: Gold price floor seen at $350 -Canadian official.
newsitem.headline: Gold price floor seen at $350 -Canadian official.

text.p: The gold price should find a floor around $350 per ounce since increasing numbers of mining firms will have to cut output if prices decline below that level, a Canadian government mining official said.

About 10 percent of world gold production costs are above $350, so that price should give good long-term support to the market, Keith Brewer, an official with Natural Resources Canada, told a government-sponsored seminar in London.
"If the price falls below $350, the marginal mines will close, reducing supply, and cause the price to rally," he said.
Gold fixed in London on Thursday afternoon at $352.00, compared to a 3-3/4 year low of $336.90 on February 12.
